name: bone
description: The skeleton's piece: the shape of something still to come (a line of words, a box, a dot, a memo's waveform), in --bone with one shimmer band shared by every bone on the screen. Every loading page draws its skeleton from it, inside its real frame.

form.description: line: one bar, 12px tall (height to change it), round ends. block: a box (a play button, a tool), width by height, 4px corners. round: a circle, width across (a day's mood dot). text: prose lines at the prose line height, a 12px bar centred in each (lines: their widths), so the skeleton is as tall as the words. spread: count bars of width each (40px) and height (12px), spread evenly across a --tap row: a mood row's five words, or a week's seven day dots (as tall as wide, they are round). wave: the memo's waveform itself (the wave module) in bone. status: the skeleton's announced line, visually hidden, role status. Written as data-form; line writes nothing.

size.description: text only: body sets the prose's type (--t-body at --lh-body); inherit takes the parent's (a Reflections leaf's 30px headline, its words at --t-field), so the lines sit in the real line boxes. height sets the bars' thickness (12px).

width.description: A CSS length or percentage ("150px", "62%"); 100% by default. For round, its diameter.

height.description: A CSS length; 12px by default (line), the box's height (block).

lines.description: text: each line's width as a fraction of the row, e.g. [1, 0.62].

text.description: status: the announced words, e.g. "Opening your journal.".

count.description: spread: how many bars (5 by default).

exposes.--aj-c-bone-w: its width, written by the width prop (inline): a length or percentage; a round bone's diameter
exposes.--aj-c-bone-h: its height, written by the height prop (inline): 12px by default

states.default: yes: the bone at rest, the shimmer passing
states.loading: yes: it is the loading state; still (no shimmer) under reduced motion, the review switch respected
states.empty: n/a: a bone stands for content still to come

a11y.role: none: aria-hidden; form status is role status, visually hidden

responsive.all: its width by prop (a percentage follows its parent); the shimmer band is the viewport's width

changelog.change: v4 round 10: the skeleton bone, out of Ask's skeleton (chat 0.2.1): one bone, its shimmer and its reduced guard, for every loading page.
v4 round 10 fixes 5: size inherit for text (the parent's type), and height thickens a text bone's bars (a headline's lines).

places.fill: the wave in form wave: painted in bone with the shimmer
